🌋 40 years of Mount Etna eruptions through the eyes of our satellites 📍 Mount Etna — Sicily, Italy In the 1980s, when Etna erupted, we watched from afar. Limited resolution and revisit times. Days before data could be fully analysed. The volcano was active, but our eyes in space were still learning to see. Today, the volcano still stands, but in a completely different technological era. Our Earth observation ecosystem is now much faster, sharper and smarter. Thanks to satellite imagery, we’ve been able to track four decades of eruptions, lava flows, and landscape transformations with unprecedented precision: 📈 Better understanding volcanic dynamics ⚡ Anticipating risks 🚒 Protecting communities and infrastructure 🔬 Supporting scientific research 👇📸 These SPOT satellite images of Mount Etna, captured between 1989 and 2025, are more than a geological timeline. What makes them truly fascinating is not only the volcanic activity itself, but also the technological revolution behind these images seen from space. As a bonus, the last snapshot below is an Amplitude Change Detection image. Created from 4 individual acquisitions performed by our Radar Constellation, its colorisation shows the structural changes of the volcano’s surface between 2008 and 2019. 📸 Want to explore the SPOT 6 image in full resolution? Discover it in our image gallery : space-solutions.airbus.com/r… #40YearsandBeyond #EarthObservation #SatelliteImagery #SpaceTechnology #Innovation #RiskManagement

But the Hormuz story isn’t just about geopolitics. #CutTheClutter looks at its strategic importance, geography & geology. 2. What is the current war (or any war) in the Gulf region about? There are 2 motives: Oil & gas and protection of Israel. In this war, both have merged. Iran has now unveiled its strongest card — block supply of oil & gas. How? Through the marvel of geology called the Strait of Hormuz. 3. The Strait of Hormuz, at its widest, is 52 nautical miles & at its narrowest, is just 21 nautical miles. Remember, 12 nautical miles is any country’s territorial waters. So, Iranians are sitting on top of this narrowest part & that’s why this becomes the most significant choke point in global energy shipping. 4. At its deepest, the Strait is 200-300 m, which makes it shallow enough to drop anti-ship mines. Iran has also packed the area with a network of missiles, air defences, drone stations. History of naval warfare shows the success of defending these narrow passages (Gallipoli). 5. In normal times, about 138 ships, mostly tankers, would pass through this channel each day. Now it’s down to low single digits. Saudi Arabia & the UAE have built pipelines, but they can’t quite fulfil global needs. China buys about 20% of LNG coming out if Middle East, India (15%), Pakistan (6.6%), Bangladesh (3.6%). 6. We are pleased to welcome back Dr. Deepak Mishra as a Distinguished Professor (Visiting) at ICRIER. Dr. Mishra currently serves as Adviser to the World Development Report 2026 on AI for Development and previously led ICRIER as its Director and Chief Executive from 2021 to 2025. Dr. Mishra’s research area lies at the intersection of technology and development, with a particular focus on digital transformation, jobs, growth and globalization. With more than two decades of experience at the World Bank, he has worked across Africa, South Asia, and East Asia, and co-directed the World Development Report 2016: Digital Dividends. Dr. Mishra holds an M.A. in Economics from the Delhi School of Economics and a Ph.D. in Economics from the University of Maryland. To learn more about his work, please visit: mishradeepak.com We look forward to benefiting from his insights and leadership in advancing research and policy dialogue at ICRIER.

The national army was founded to serve as the shield of the country and the guardian of its sovereignty. It was never established to become a party to internal conflict among the sons and daughters of the same nation. The army’s combat doctrine, rooted in military law and tradition, is founded upon the protection of the homeland, the defence of its land and people, and the preservation of civil peace and the unity of the state. Placing the army in confrontation with its own people, or assigning it the task of pursuing those resisting foreign aggression against the country, would constitute a dangerous precedent carrying serious risks for the cohesion of the military institution and the stability of the nation. Decisions of this nature could weaken the army’s historic role as a unifying national institution and expose its internal unity to grave and potentially disastrous consequences. The unity of the army is not merely an administrative or organisational matter. It is a cornerstone of the state itself and of the stability of the nation. Any decision that places the army in opposition to its own society, or that distances it from its fundamental national mission, carries with it the risk of division and institutional weakening. Such a delicate phase therefore demands the highest degree of wisdom, responsibility, and foresight. From this perspective, we reaffirm that the protection of the homeland, its sovereignty, and its territorial integrity remains the supreme objective we have sworn to defend. Safeguarding the cohesion of the military institution and preventing any course that could lead to its fragmentation is a national responsibility that rests upon all authorities and institutions of the state. We therefore warn of the grave repercussions that could result from decisions capable of pushing the country toward internal division or placing the army in a position that contradicts its unifying national mission. We call for a careful reassessment of any measures that might endanger the unity of the armed forces or the stability of the nation. The true strength of the army does not lie solely in its military capabilities, but equally in its internal cohesion and in the confidence, trust, and support of the people it serves. The army will remain, as it has always been, a national institution that brings together all the sons and daughters of the nation and stands as a bulwark protecting the country from danger while preserving its unity and sovereignty. German Delegation from Global Bridges Visits NITI Aayog to Learn About Aspirational District and Block Programme! A delegation from Global Bridges, Germany, visited NITI Aayog to gain insights into the Government of India’s flagship initiatives — the Aspirational District Programme (ADP) and Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP) — aimed at accelerating development outcomes and strengthening service delivery at the district and block levels. The interaction was chaired by Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary and Mission Director, ADP/ABP, NITI Aayog, who briefed the delegation on the Aspirational District Programme (ADP) and the Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP). He highlighted how these flagship initiatives are built on the principles of 3C — Convergence, Collaboration and Competition and 3F — Funds, Functions and Functionaries, which are helping accelerate development outcomes at the district and block levels. Shri Rohit Kumar also explained how the ADP and ABP frameworks leverage data-driven monitoring, real-time dashboards, and field-level convergence to track progress across key sectors such as health, education, agriculture, and basic infrastructure. The delegation, headed by Dr. Stefan Traeger, appreciated the transformational impact of the Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programmes and acknowledged the robust monitoring mechanism and data-based governance model adopted under ADP/ABP. The delegation further visited the Viksit Bharat Strategy Room, where the NITI team showcased how data-driven analytics and visualisation tools are being used to generate insights, identify development gaps, and support evidence-based policymaking across the Centre, States, and districts. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #AspirationalDistricts #AspirationalBlocks #DataDrivenGovernance #ViksitBharat #GlobalPartnerships

Did you know 😏 He rubbed lemon juice on his face. Robbed two banks. Smiled at the cameras. Got caught in an hour. And changed psychology forever. In 1995, McArthur Wheeler walked into two banks in Pittsburgh and robbed them with no mask, no disguise, and lemon juice on his face. He believed that because lemon juice works as invisible ink on paper, it would make his face invisible to cameras. He smiled directly into the security cameras. Police aired the footage on the evening news and arrested him within an hour. When shown the tape, Wheeler stared at the screen and said, "But I wore the juice." He had tested the theory with a Polaroid selfie and didn't appear in the photo — because lemon juice got in his eyes and he aimed the camera at the ceiling. His case inspired Cornell psychologists David Dunning and Justin Kruger to publish their 1999 paper defining the Dunning-Kruger Effect — the cognitive bias where people with low ability drastically overestimate their own competence.

UN ESTUDIO REVELÓ QUE LOS ANTIBIÓTICOS PUEDEN AFECTAR EL MICROBIOMA INTESTINAL DURANTE VARIOS AÑOS Una investigación publicada en Nature Medicine y liderada por la Universidad de Uppsala detectó que ciertos antibióticos modifican la diversidad bacteriana del intestino hasta ocho años después de su uso. El análisis, realizado en casi 15.000 adultos, mostró que antibióticos como clindamicina, fluoroquinolonas y flucloxacilina generan alteraciones persistentes, mientras que la penicilina V presenta cambios menores y temporales. El estudio advierte que el impacto sobre el microbioma puede influir en la salud metabólica e inmunitaria, y resalta la importancia de una prescripción responsable. Las autoridades sanitarias y expertos enfatizan la necesidad de estrategias de prevención y buenas prácticas en el uso de antimicrobianos para enfrentar la resistencia bacteriana y preservar la eficacia de estos medicamentos. 🔗 Infobae: infob.ae/40Z448B

Israel believed Hezbollah had been severely weakened and appeared to be counting on drawing the United States into a war with Iran in order to complete what it saw as a decisive campaign against Hezbollah. That calculation now appears far less certain. Israel has entered the phase it once warned its adversaries about: the moment when a “heavy price” begins to be paid. Hezbollah’s recent escalation is turning the narrative of victory promoted by Benjamin Netanyahu and his defence minister Israel Katz against them. The situation on the ground reflects this reversal. The Israeli government had initially urged residents of the north to remain in place, projecting confidence in its ability to control the escalation. Now those same populations are being urged to evacuate as quickly as possible. Such a shift carries political consequences, undermining the government’s claims of strategic success and exposing the gap between official messaging and battlefield realities. If Hezbollah is capable of launching around one hundred missiles of different calibres in a single wave, including systems such as the Fateh-110, it suggests that its arsenal remains significantly larger than many intelligence assessments had anticipated. Rather than signalling exhaustion, the scale and variety of launches indicate that Hezbollah retains substantial strike capacity despite months of pressure. At the same time, Israel’s strategy of forcing the evacuation of the Shia population from the southern suburbs of Beirut, more than eighty villages in southern Lebanon, and areas of the Bekaa Valley may have produced an unintended effect. By emptying civilian areas that Hezbollah traditionally seeks to protect, Israel may have reduced one of the movement’s operational constraints. The message inadvertently sent is that Hezbollah can now conduct operations with fewer concerns about the immediate impact on the communities it claims to defend.

When administrator privileges are widely shared and always available, a compromised account creates a bigger risk for your organization. An attacker who steals an employee’s credentials may already have high-level access or be able to quickly obtain it and move through your network. That’s why Reducing Administrator Privileges is one of Operation Winter SHIELD’s 10 Key #Cyber Defenses. Limit administrator access to those who truly need it. Even then, admin privileges should only be used when necessary, with standard accounts used for everyday tasks. Organizations should also require temporary (“just-in-time”) access from secure devices, restrict where admin logins are permitted, and monitor for new admin accounts and privilege changes. These steps are critical to prevent attackers from gaining broad control. Our Akira ransomware advisory shows how frequently attackers can create new user accounts and add them to the administrator group, establishing a foothold in a victim’s environment. Learn about Akira ransomware TTPs: ic3.gov/CSA/2025/251113.pdf. And follow the #FBI #OWS campaign at fbi.gov/wintershield

【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

In response to a question about expectations regarding support from the German Parliament. At the beginning of the year, an important meeting of the Coalition of the Willing was held in Paris, during which a decision was made regarding security guarantees – specifically the part that depends on our European colleagues. The co-chairing countries – the United Kingdom and France – signed the corresponding declaration. This declaration is then forwarded to the parliaments of European countries that are ready to support it at their level. We hope that German parliamentarians will back Germany’s participation in security guarantees once the war is over. Second, financial support. Germany is the largest supporter of our army. Such decisions depend on parliamentary approval. There is the PURL initiative, through which we have the ability to purchase missiles for the Patriot systems. These are ongoing funding allocations, with decisions made both at the government level and by parliamentarians. For us, this is very important. Third, we are preparing an energy plan to protect Ukraine’s energy sector, particularly focusing on decentralizing the energy system to defend against Russia. Protection is needed in various forms: additional gas and electricity supplies, building interconnectors. There's also a need to technically increase import capacity from Europe in case of shortages. Beyond that, there are boiler plants, wind and solar generation, and much more. We are counting on Germany’s support in this area. Equally important is the involvement of the European Union and Germany in the negotiation process. Because this track includes topics such as Ukraine’s recovery, Europe’s security infrastructure, and Ukraine’s EU membership. Each of these matters is significant, and we expect support on them. It depends on the parliaments, because this reflects the country’s position. From a media briefing ahead of the meeting with the President of the German Bundestag, Julia Klöckner (1/3)

جوان افغان‌تبار متهم به تلاش برای حمله انفجاری در نیویارک؛ ابراهیم کیومی کیست؟ ابراهیم کیومی، جوان ۱۹ ساله باشنده نیوتاون در ایالت پنسیلوانیا، در مرکز یک پرونده تروریستی قرار گرفته که به گفته مقام‌های امریکایی می‌توانست به یک حمله مرگبار در نیویارک تبدیل شود. او همراه با امیر بالت ۱۸ ساله متهم است که روز ۷ مارچ ۲۰۲۶ در جریان تجمع‌ها و ضدتجمع‌ها در نزدیکی «گریسی منشن»، اقامتگاه رسمی شاروال نیویارک، دو وسیله انفجاری دست‌ساز را به سوی جمعیت پرتاب کردند. این تجمع در پی برگزاری یک تظاهرات ضداسلامی برگزار شده بود و ده‌ها نفر از معترضان و ضد‌معترضان در محل حضور داشتند. پولیس می‌گوید این مواد منفجره می‌توانست به کشته و زخمی شدن افراد زیادی منجر شود، اما خوشبختانه هیچ‌یک از آن‌ها منفجر نشد. بر بنیاد اسناد قضایی، یکی از این وسایل انفجاری حاوی ماده بسیار خطرناک «تری‌استون تری‌پراکساید» یا TATP بوده که به دلیل بی‌ثباتی شدید و قدرت تخریبی زیاد به «مادر شیطان» مشهور است. این وسیله‌ها همچنان دارای فتیله و قطعات فلزی مانند پیچ و مهره بودند تا در صورت انفجار آسیب بیشتری وارد کنند. در جریان حادثه، امیر بالت نخست یک وسیله انفجاری را به سوی جمعیت پرتاب کرد و سپس وسیله دوم را که از سوی ابراهیم کیومی به او داده شده بود روشن کرده و در نزدیکی محل حضور پولیس انداخت. نیروهای امنیتی هر دو نفر را اندکی بعد در محل بازداشت کردند. در جریان تحقیقات، مقام‌ها گفته‌اند که کیومی در پاسخ به پرسش‌ها درباره انگیزه‌اش، از گروه داعش نام برده است. در اسناد قضایی آمده که او هنگام انتقال به موتر پولیس در پاسخ به فردی که پرسیده بود چرا چنین کاری کرده، گفت: «داعش». همچنان در بازجویی‌ها گفته است که ویدیوها و تبلیغات این گروه را در تلفن همراهش تماشا کرده و اقدام او تا حدی تحت تأثیر همین محتوا بوده است. در همین حال، امیر بالت نیز به پولیس گفته است که قصد داشته حمله‌ای «حتی بزرگ‌تر از بمب‌گذاری ماراتون بوستون» انجام دهد. ابراهیم کیومی فرزند مهاجران افغان است که سال‌ها پیش به ایالات متحده مهاجرت کرده و بعداً شهروند این کشور شده‌اند. خانواده او ابتدا در نیویارک زندگی می‌کردند و حدود سال ۲۰۰۵ به منطقه باکس‌کانتی در ایالت پنسیلوانیا نقل مکان کردند. او بیشتر عمر خود را در امریکا سپری کرده و در سال ۲۰۲۴ از مکتب Council Rock High School North فارغ شده است. پس از بازداشت او، مأموران اف‌بی‌آی خانه خانواده‌اش در نیوتاون را نیز مورد تلاشی قرار دادند. گزارش‌ها نشان می‌دهد خانواده کیومی از نظر اقتصادی در وضعیت نسبتاً خوبی قرار دارند. گفته می‌شود پدر او در بخش تجارت و املاک سرمایه‌گذاری کرده و مالک چندین ملک مسکونی در باکس‌کانتی است. خانواده در یک خانه بزرگ در نیوتاون زندگی می‌کنند و بر اساس برخی اسناد ملکی، دارایی‌های ملکی آنان به چندین میلیون دالر می‌رسد. پدر کیومی همچنان در یک شعبه رستورانت زنجیره‌ای «پاپایز» سهم دارد و در کنار آن چندین واحد مسکونی دیگر نیز در اختیار دارد.

He now smears FM Araghchi — who, unlike him, is a seasoned and notoriously serious diplomat — claiming the Iranian foreign minister lacked willingness to reach a deal, lacked authority, was threatening, shouting, and all sorts of other nonsense. The truth is very different. In one of the three rounds of negotiations, Witkoff showed up late to the meeting and then went off to have breakfast. He had no knowledge whatsoever of the technical nuclear issues under discussion. He could not even use the correct terminology when referring to basic technical matters. He was clueless about past agreements, did not bother to take notes, and could not even grasp Iran’s proposals. He had not even bothered to bring along a State Department diplomat or a technical expert who could explain to him what the Iranian negotiators were actually talking about. At the first meeting in Geneva, he cut the discussion short to attend talks on Ukraine, which he had conveniently scheduled on the same day to avoid having to travel twice. In another meeting, he reportedly stepped off his private plane half sober and pretended to agree with everything Iran proposed, only to later reverse himself and tell a completely different story to U.S. media. FM Araghchi could dismantle every one of Witkoff’s claims simply by releasing, fully or even partially, Iran’s proposals. That alone would show that Witkoff is either clueless, lying, or — more likely — acting on behalf of Netanyahu rather than the U.S. administration. The U.S. Congress — and the intelligence community — would do well to investigate whether he was actually pursuing American interests, or effectively taking his cues from a foreign government, namely Israel. The American people deserve to know. Ask why he pretended talks were progressing to the Iranian counterpart and the Omani mediator, and reported the opposite to his boss? In fact, if what he reported to Trump is the same fiction he is now feeding to U.S. media, then he bears direct responsibility for helping ignite a regional war. Was Witkoff a traitor to his boss, to peace, or to both?

বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজায় নারীদের জন্য বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা ঢাকা, ৩০ ডিসেম্বর ২০২৫: বাংলাদেশ জাতীয়তাবাদী দল (বিএনপি)-এর চেয়ারপার্সন, তিনবারের সাবেক প্রধানমন্ত্রী ও গণতান্ত্রিক রাজনীতির শীর্ষ নেত্রী বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার ইন্তেকালে দেশব্যাপী গভীর শোকের আবহ বিরাজ করছে। তাঁর প্রতি শেষ শ্রদ্ধা জানাতে সর্বস্তরের মানুষের অংশগ্রহণ নিশ্চিত করতে প্রয়োজনীয় প্রস্তুতি গ্রহণ করা হয়েছে অন্তর্বর্তীকালীন সরকার। এই প্রেক্ষাপটে বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজায় অংশগ্রহণ করতে ইচ্ছুক নারীদের জন্য বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা রাখা হয়েছে। জাতীয় সংসদ ভবনের দক্ষিণ প্লাজা ও মানিক মিয়া এভিনিউ এলাকায় নারীদের জন্য পৃথকভাবে এ বিশেষ ব্যবস্থা করা হয়েছে, যাতে তাঁরা সুশৃঙ্খল ও নিরাপদ পরিবেশে জানাজায় অংশ নিতে পারেন। উল্লেখ্য, বেগম খালেদা জিয়ার নামাজে জানাজা বাদ জোহর বেলা দুইটায় অনুষ্ঠিত হবে। জানাজায় অংশগ্রহণে আগ্রহী সকলকে নিরাপত্তাজনিত কারণে কোনো প্রকার ব্যাগ বহন না করার জন্য অনুরোধ জানানো হচ্ছে। বেগম খালেদা জিয়াকে শেষ বিদায় জানাতে আগত সকলের সার্বিক নিরাপত্তা ও শৃঙ্খলা নিশ্চিত করতে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষ প্রয়োজনীয় সব ধরনের ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণ করেছে।

केमिकल इंडस्ट्रीच्या प्रगतीसाठी महाराष्ट्र शासन कटीबद्ध मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी आज '19व्या ॲन्युअल इंडिया केमिकल इंडस्ट्री आऊटलुक कॉन्फरन्स अँड एक्झिबिशन'च्या निमित्ताने आयोजित 'सीईओ राऊंडटेबल' येथे उपस्थिती दर्शविली. यावेळी मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केमिकल इंडस्ट्रीचे भविष्य व विकासाची नवी दिशा स्पष्ट केली. सूक्ष्म, लघु व मध्यम उद्योगांच्या बाबतीत महाराष्ट्र हे देशाचे केंद्र असल्याचे नमूद करत या उद्योगांसाठी पायाभूत सुविधा व प्लग-अँड-प्ले सुविधा निर्माण करण्यास महाराष्ट्र शासन प्राधान्य देत असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी सांगितले. तसेच, उद्योगांसाठी पर्यावरणाशी संबंधित परवानग्या आता अधिक पारदर्शक आणि वेगवान झाल्या असल्याचे अधोरेखित केले. शिक्षण आणि उद्योग यांच्यातील समन्वयावर मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी विशेष भर दिला. यासह उद्योगांना आवश्यक असलेले प्रशिक्षित मनुष्यबळ उपलब्ध करून देण्यासाठी आयटीआय (ITI) आणि इतर नामांकित शिक्षण संस्थांसोबत भागीदारीचे महत्त्व अधोरेखित केले. तसेच, केमिकल इंडस्ट्रीसाठी एक स्वतंत्र आणि सर्वसमावेशक धोरण तयार करण्यासाठी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी या क्षेत्रातील उद्योजकांना निमंत्रित केले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले की, यापूर्वी दरवर्षी वीज दरात 9% वाढ होत असे, मात्र आता नवीन नियमांनुसार पुढील पाच वर्षांत वीज दरात कोणतीही वाढ होणार नाही, उलट त्यात दरवर्षी 1.2% कपात होऊन एकूण 9% कपात होईल. यावेळी केमिकल इंडस्ट्रीशी संबंधित मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Mumbai

In response to a question about expectations regarding support from the German Parliament. At the beginning of the year, an important meeting of the Coalition of the Willing was held in Paris, during which a decision was made regarding security guarantees – specifically the part that depends on our European colleagues. The co-chairing countries – the United Kingdom and France – signed the corresponding declaration. This declaration is then forwarded to the parliaments of European countries that are ready to support it at their level. We hope that German parliamentarians will back Germany’s participation in security guarantees once the war is over. Second, financial support. Germany is the largest supporter of our army. Such decisions depend on parliamentary approval. There is the PURL initiative, through which we have the ability to purchase missiles for the Patriot systems. These are ongoing funding allocations, with decisions made both at the government level and by parliamentarians. For us, this is very important. Third, we are preparing an energy plan to protect Ukraine’s energy sector, particularly focusing on decentralizing the energy system to defend against Russia. Protection is needed in various forms: additional gas and electricity supplies, building interconnectors. There's also a need to technically increase import capacity from Europe in case of shortages. Beyond that, there are boiler plants, wind and solar generation, and much more. We are counting on Germany’s support in this area. Equally important is the involvement of the European Union and Germany in the negotiation process. Because this track includes topics such as Ukraine’s recovery, Europe’s security infrastructure, and Ukraine’s EU membership. Each of these matters is significant, and we expect support on them. It depends on the parliaments, because this reflects the country’s position. From a media briefing ahead of the meeting with the President of the German Bundestag, Julia Klöckner (1/3)

Opened the second Nuclear Energy Summit in Paris today with President @EmmanuelMacron. Hosted by 🇫🇷 @francediplo_EN in cooperation with the @IAEAorg, #NES2026 comes at a moment when nuclear energy is increasingly recognized as a tool of autonomy, industrial competitiveness and geopolitical resilience. When we speak about development, we speak about electrification, digitalization and artificial intelligence. In all these areas, we will need reliable and predictable answers. Nuclear energy is one of those answers. Reliable, low-carbon and independent of weather or fuel supply disruptions, nuclear power provides stable electricity systems and supports energy security. Its baseload reliability also enables the deployment of renewables and will be essential as electricity demand surges, including from the AI revolution. Today, around 60 countries are considering nuclear energy. But momentum alone is not enough: nuclear must be investible. Predictable policies, robust supply chains and accessible financing are essential to reduce costs and scale up its deployment, alongside greater standardization so the industry can move toward repeatable designs. We are making great progress. The @IAEAorg is working with international financial institutions to expand access to nuclear energy, including partnerships with the @WorldBank, @AgendaCAF, @TheOPECFund and @ADB_HQ. Nuclear power is not simply a nice-to-have, or a cleaner option. It is a strategic opportunity and we know it. As the global hub of expertise across the nuclear lifecycle, the @IAEAorg will continue supporting countries as they move to seize it.

২৫ ফেব্রুয়ারি 'জাতীয় শহীদ সেনা দিবস' উপলক্ষ্যে আয়োজিত ইফতার-২০২৬ অনুষ্ঠিত ঢাকা, ২৫ ফেব্রুয়ারি ২০২৬ (বুধবার): গত ২৫-২৬ ফেব্রুয়ারি ২০০৯ তারিখে বিডিআর (বর্তমানে বিজিবি) সদর দপ্তর, পিলখানায় সংঘটিত বর্বরোচিত হত্যাকান্ডে বাংলাদেশ সেনাবাহিনীর শহিদ সেনাসদস্যগণের ১৭তম শাহাদত বার্ষিকী স্মরণে এবং শহিদ পরিবারের সদস্যবৃন্দের সম্মানে আজ (২৫ ফেব্রুয়ারি ২০২৬) সন্ধ্যায় ঢাকা সেনানিবাসস্থ আর্মি মাল্টিপারপাস কমপ্লেক্সে একটি মতবিনিময় সভা ও ইফতার অনুষ্ঠান আয়োজন করা হয়। উক্ত অনুষ্ঠানে প্রধান অতিথি হিসেবে গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী জনাব তারেক রহমান উপস্থিত ছিলেন। তিনি শহিদ পরিবারের সদস্যগণের সঙ্গে কুশল বিনিময় করেন এবং তাদের খোঁজ খবর নেন। পাশাপাশি, মতবিনিময় সভায় শহীদ পরিবারের সদস্যবৃন্দ তাঁদের বিভিন্ন দাবি ও প্রাসঙ্গিক বিষয়সমূহ মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রীর নিকট উপস্থাপন করেন। মাননীয় প্রধানমন্ত্রী এ সকল বিষয় গুরুত্বের সঙ্গে বিবেচনা করে পর্যায়ক্রমে বাস্তবসম্মত পদক্ষেপ গ্রহণের অঙ্গীকার ব্যক্ত করেন। উক্ত ইফতার অনুষ্ঠানে গণপ্রজাতন্ত্রী বাংলাদেশ সরকারের মাননীয় স্বরাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রী; প্রতিরক্ষা উপদেষ্টা; সেনা, নৌ ও বিমান বাহিনীর প্রধানগণ; প্রধানমন্ত্রীর মুখ্যসচিব; ঊর্ধ্বতন সামরিক ও অসামরিক কর্মকর্তাবৃন্দ; শহিদ পরিবারের সদস্যগণ এবং গণমাধ্যম ব্যক্তিবর্গ উপস্থিত ছিলেন।

جوان افغان‌تبار متهم به تلاش برای حمله انفجاری در نیویارک؛ ابراهیم کیومی کیست؟ ابراهیم کیومی، جوان ۱۹ ساله باشنده نیوتاون در ایالت پنسیلوانیا، در مرکز یک پرونده تروریستی قرار گرفته که به گفته مقام‌های امریکایی می‌توانست به یک حمله مرگبار در نیویارک تبدیل شود. او همراه با امیر بالت ۱۸ ساله متهم است که روز ۷ مارچ ۲۰۲۶ در جریان تجمع‌ها و ضدتجمع‌ها در نزدیکی «گریسی منشن»، اقامتگاه رسمی شاروال نیویارک، دو وسیله انفجاری دست‌ساز را به سوی جمعیت پرتاب کردند. این تجمع در پی برگزاری یک تظاهرات ضداسلامی برگزار شده بود و ده‌ها نفر از معترضان و ضد‌معترضان در محل حضور داشتند. پولیس می‌گوید این مواد منفجره می‌توانست به کشته و زخمی شدن افراد زیادی منجر شود، اما خوشبختانه هیچ‌یک از آن‌ها منفجر نشد. بر بنیاد اسناد قضایی، یکی از این وسایل انفجاری حاوی ماده بسیار خطرناک «تری‌استون تری‌پراکساید» یا TATP بوده که به دلیل بی‌ثباتی شدید و قدرت تخریبی زیاد به «مادر شیطان» مشهور است. این وسیله‌ها همچنان دارای فتیله و قطعات فلزی مانند پیچ و مهره بودند تا در صورت انفجار آسیب بیشتری وارد کنند. در جریان حادثه، امیر بالت نخست یک وسیله انفجاری را به سوی جمعیت پرتاب کرد و سپس وسیله دوم را که از سوی ابراهیم کیومی به او داده شده بود روشن کرده و در نزدیکی محل حضور پولیس انداخت. نیروهای امنیتی هر دو نفر را اندکی بعد در محل بازداشت کردند. در جریان تحقیقات، مقام‌ها گفته‌اند که کیومی در پاسخ به پرسش‌ها درباره انگیزه‌اش، از گروه داعش نام برده است. در اسناد قضایی آمده که او هنگام انتقال به موتر پولیس در پاسخ به فردی که پرسیده بود چرا چنین کاری کرده، گفت: «داعش». همچنان در بازجویی‌ها گفته است که ویدیوها و تبلیغات این گروه را در تلفن همراهش تماشا کرده و اقدام او تا حدی تحت تأثیر همین محتوا بوده است. در همین حال، امیر بالت نیز به پولیس گفته است که قصد داشته حمله‌ای «حتی بزرگ‌تر از بمب‌گذاری ماراتون بوستون» انجام دهد. ابراهیم کیومی فرزند مهاجران افغان است که سال‌ها پیش به ایالات متحده مهاجرت کرده و بعداً شهروند این کشور شده‌اند. خانواده او ابتدا در نیویارک زندگی می‌کردند و حدود سال ۲۰۰۵ به منطقه باکس‌کانتی در ایالت پنسیلوانیا نقل مکان کردند. او بیشتر عمر خود را در امریکا سپری کرده و در سال ۲۰۲۴ از مکتب Council Rock High School North فارغ شده است. پس از بازداشت او، مأموران اف‌بی‌آی خانه خانواده‌اش در نیوتاون را نیز مورد تلاشی قرار دادند. گزارش‌ها نشان می‌دهد خانواده کیومی از نظر اقتصادی در وضعیت نسبتاً خوبی قرار دارند. گفته می‌شود پدر او در بخش تجارت و املاک سرمایه‌گذاری کرده و مالک چندین ملک مسکونی در باکس‌کانتی است. خانواده در یک خانه بزرگ در نیوتاون زندگی می‌کنند و بر اساس برخی اسناد ملکی، دارایی‌های ملکی آنان به چندین میلیون دالر می‌رسد. پدر کیومی همچنان در یک شعبه رستورانت زنجیره‌ای «پاپایز» سهم دارد و در کنار آن چندین واحد مسکونی دیگر نیز در اختیار دارد.

WHO has delivered five vials of urgently needed botulism antitoxin to Da Nang to support three critically ill patients with suspected botulism. This rare, life‑saving medicine can prevent further harm and improve recovery when given quickly. After receiving the alert from national health authorities, WHO rapidly mobilized across its country office, regional office, and headquarters to source the antitoxin from the global stockpile in Geneva and arrange immediate transport to Viet Nam. WHO worked closely with the Ministry of Health, local health teams, and logistics partners to ensure the vials arrived as fast and safely as possible. Dr Angela Pratt, WHO Representative in Viet Nam, expressed deep concern for the patients and gratitude to the medical teams providing round‑the‑clock care. She emphasized that this rapid deployment highlights the importance of strong partnerships and preparedness, and reaffirmed WHO’s commitment to supporting Viet Nam’s health security. WHO also thanked The Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency @KoreaDCA for its continued partnership and support. Read more: who.int/vietnam/news/detail/…

NITI Aayog Releases Second Edition of the Fiscal Health Index (FY 2023–24) Shri Suman Bery, Vice Chairman, NITI Aayog, released the second edition of the Fiscal Health Index (FHI) on 11 March 2026 in New Delhi, in the presence of senior officials of NITI Aayog. The publication presents a comprehensive, data-driven assessment of the fiscal performance of Indian States and serves as a benchmarking framework to support informed policymaking and improved fiscal management at the State level. The Index assesses States across five key pillars: Quality of Expenditure, Revenue Mobilisation, Fiscal Prudence, Debt Index, and Debt Sustainability. Together, these indicators provide a structured approach to evaluating fiscal health and identifying opportunities for strengthening public financial management. In its second edition, the Index broadens its coverage by incorporating 10 North-Eastern and Himalayan States, making the analysis more inclusive and reflective of India’s fiscal landscape. Among the 18 major States, Odisha secured the top position, followed by Goa and Jharkhand. Among the North-Eastern and Himalayan States, Arunachal Pradesh ranked first, followed by Uttarakhand and Tripura, highlighting notable progress in fiscal discipline, revenue generation, expenditure quality and debt management. The report underlines the need to strengthen revenue mobilisation, rationalise committed expenditure to enhance fiscal flexibility, improve the composition and effectiveness of capital expenditure, and advance fiscal transparency and public financial management systems to ensure sustainable fiscal outcomes. Foreign Minister Mr Bala Nanda Sharma and Foreign Secretary Mr Amrit Bahadur Rai on the recent developments in West Asia, the current status of Nepali citizens in the region, and Nepal’s successful initiative at the United Nations regarding International Wellness Day. During the programme, updates were shared on the ongoing efforts of the Government to ensure the safety and protection of Nepali nationals, including the creation of an Emergency Response Team (ERT) led by the Foreign Secretary, the digital registration platform at the Department of Consular Services, and a 24-hour hotline service operated by the Emergency Control Room (ECR) in the Ministry. The Hon. Foreign Minister and the Foreign Secretary spoke on the ongoing efforts to ensure the safety of Nepali nationals in the region and to facilitate, as necessary, their safe return. They also highlighted the significance of International Wellness Day, underscoring the importance of promoting and projecting Nepal’s soft power in this regard. German Delegation from Global Bridges Visits NITI Aayog to Learn About Aspirational District and Block Programme! A delegation from Global Bridges, Germany, visited NITI Aayog to gain insights into the Government of India’s flagship initiatives — the Aspirational District Programme (ADP) and Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP) — aimed at accelerating development outcomes and strengthening service delivery at the district and block levels. The interaction was chaired by Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary and Mission Director, ADP/ABP, NITI Aayog, who briefed the delegation on the Aspirational District Programme (ADP) and the Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP). He highlighted how these flagship initiatives are built on the principles of 3C — Convergence, Collaboration and Competition and 3F — Funds, Functions and Functionaries, which are helping accelerate development outcomes at the district and block levels. Shri Rohit Kumar also explained how the ADP and ABP frameworks leverage data-driven monitoring, real-time dashboards, and field-level convergence to track progress across key sectors such as health, education, agriculture, and basic infrastructure. The delegation, headed by Dr. Stefan Traeger, appreciated the transformational impact of the Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programmes and acknowledged the robust monitoring mechanism and data-based governance model adopted under ADP/ABP. The delegation further visited the Viksit Bharat Strategy Room, where the NITI team showcased how data-driven analytics and visualisation tools are being used to generate insights, identify development gaps, and support evidence-based policymaking across the Centre, States, and districts. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #AspirationalDistricts #AspirationalBlocks #DataDrivenGovernance #ViksitBharat #GlobalPartnerships

The newly-appointed Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today, marking the official assumption of his post as the Ambassador of the Kingdom of Spain to ASEAN. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda on his appointment and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with him and the Government of Spain to strengthen ASEAN-Spain relations, both through bilateral copperation and within the framework of the ASEAN-European Union Dialogue Partnership. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda underscored Spain’s commitment to advancing cooperation with ASEAN in strategic sectors, such as trade and investment, sustainable infrastructure, energy transition, digital transformation, and connectivity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao further encouraged the Ambassador to engage with the diplomatic community in Jakarta, in particular with the Committee of Permanent Representatives to ASEAN (CPR). Both sides looked forward to Spain's accession to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) this year. Ambassador de Sicart Escoda also informed of Spain's intention to establish mechanisms for political dialogue and cooperation with ASEAN, in line with Spain's Strategy for the Asia-Pacific 2026–2029. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda is the fifth Ambassador of Spain to ASEAN. He succeeds Ambassador Francisco Aguilera Aranda, who completed his tenure in July 2025.

When allegations are made against the head of this House, questions are raised not only within the country but also globally about our democratic processes. Yet, questions are now being raised about the very person entrusted with this mediating role. I will explain later why such questions are being raised. जुर्माना लगाकर फंस गए मोहसिन नकवी! पूर्व कप्तान ने लगाई 'आग', PCB के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन करेगी पाकिस्तान टीम? T20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 में पाकिस्तान टीम का सफर सुपर-8 स्टेज के बाद ही समाप्त हो गया था. इसके बाद खिलाड़ियों के खराब प्रदर्शन से गुस्साए मोहसिन नकवी ने सलमान अली आगा की अगुवाई वाली टीम पर तगड़ा जुर्माना लगाने का फैसला किया. दुनियाभर में PCB के इस निर्णय को लेकर चर्चा हो रही है. अब 2009 में पाकिस्तान को टी20 वर्ल्ड कप का खिताब जिताने वाले कप्तान यूनुस खान ने ऐसी चिंगारी लगाई है, जिससे मोहसिन नकवी और पाकिस्तान क्रिकेट बोर्ड तबाह हो सकता है. यूनुस खान ने पाकिस्तान खिलाड़ियों से इस फैसले के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन करने की सलाह दी है. उनके अनुसार टी20 वर्ल्ड कप में खराब प्रदर्शन के बाद खिलाड़ियों पर जुर्माना लगाना बेबुनियाद है. यूनुस के अलावा पूर्व खिलाड़ी राशिद लतीफ ने भी पीसीबी की जमकर आलोचना की. . . कई रिपोर्टों के अनुसार, मोहसिन नकवी की अगुवाई वाली पीसीबी ने सेमीफाइनल में न पहुंच पाने के कारण पाकिस्तान की पूरी टीम पर जुर्माना लगाया है. ईएसपीएनक्रिकइंफो के मुताबिक, टीम के सभी सदस्यों पर 50 लाख पाकिस्तानी रुपये (लगभग 18,000 अमेरिकी डॉलर) का जुर्माना लगाया गया है. इससे भी बुरी बात यह है कि यह फैसला भारत के खिलाफ पाकिस्तान की हार के बाद लिया गया, लेकिन एक शर्त के साथ, अगर टीम सेमीफाइनल में पहुंच जाती तो जुर्माना माफ कर दिया जाता. यूनुस खान ने कहा कि 2003 में भी पीसीबी द्वारा खिलाड़ियों पर जुर्माना लगाए जाने के मामले सामने आए थे, लेकिन खिलाड़ियों ने इसके खिलाफ आवाज उठाई और फैसले को पलटना पड़ा. पाकिस्तान के पूर्व कप्तान ने रिपोर्टर से बातचीत करते हुए कहा, ''क्या यह बात पक्की है? अगर पक्की है, तो यह सही नहीं है. पहले भी ऐसा ही एक मामला हुआ था. 2003 में, जब हम विश्व कप के बाद लौटे, राशिद लतीफ को कप्तान बनाया गया. उन्हें पीसीबी से संदेश मिला कि मैच फीस आधी कर दी जाएगी और भत्ते भी आधे कर दिए जाएंगे. एक-दो खिलाड़ियों ने इसका विरोध किया था. अब खिलाड़ियों को अपना रुख स्पष्ट करना होगा. अगर खिलाड़ी रुख स्पष्ट करते हैं, तो उन पर जुर्माना नहीं लगेगा.'' #PCB #PakistanCricket #MohsinNaqvi #PakistanNews

Thematic Sessions of the Regional Best Practices Seminar (South) under Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme at NITI Aayog The Regional Best Practices Seminar (South) under the Aspirational Districts and Blocks Programme (ADP/ABP) was held in Vishakhapatnam, bringing together District Collectors, state officials and development practitioners from across southern India. The seminar featured three thematic technical sessions highlighting district-led interventions in Education and Skill Development; Health, Nutrition and Social Development; and Skill Development across Aspirational Districts and Blocks. Technical Session I on Education and Skill Development showcased innovative initiatives including the NIRMAN initiative from Alluri Sitarama Raju district, aimed at improving foundational learning outcomes, and the Rural Incubation Centre model from NTR district, which promotes innovation and entrepreneurship among rural youth. Technical Sessions II and III on Health, Nutrition and Skill Development highlighted impactful best practices such as the Anaemia Mukt initiative from Bidar district, addressing anaemia among women and children, and the Amma Rakshitha programme from Nirmal district, focused on improving maternal health outcomes. Additional innovative practices were also shared by the District Collector of Kurnool district, showcasing district-led approaches to strengthen youth skill development. In his concluding remarks, Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary & Mission Director – ADP/ABP, NITI Aayog, emphasised the importance of documenting and scaling best practices and encouraged districts to build on successful models while fostering cross-learning. The seminar concluded with key learnings and actionable insights, reaffirming the importance of peer learning and knowledge-sharing platforms in strengthening district-led innovation and accelerating transformation in India’s most underserved regions. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #AspirationalDistricts #AspirationalBlocks #BestPractices #ADP #ABP #DistrictTransformation #DataDrivenGovernance #LastMileDelivery #TransformingIndia

ICRIER in collaboration with @Bruegel_org, hosted a panel discussion on “The Mother of All Deals? Economic Implications of the India-EU FTA” The discussion brought together leading experts Pritam Banerjee, Head, @CWS_iift; @ignaciobercero, Senior Fellow, Bruegel; @profarpita1, Professor, #ICRIER; and André Sapir, Senior Fellow, Bruegel to examine the potential economic and strategic implications of the India–EU Free Trade Agreement for both sides, as well as its impact on the global trading system. The session was moderated by @ShekharAiyar, Director & Chief Executive, ICRIER, and the keynote address was delivered by @WeyandSabine, Director-General, DG @Trade_EU @EU_Commission. The session explored several key questions, including: 🔹 What are the main benefits for India from this deal—including for labor-intensive sectors like apparel and footwear—and how will these contribute to the aim to become #ViksitBharat2047? 🔹 What are the main benefits for the EU from this deal? Which sectors and industries are expected to gain the most: is it advanced tech, capital goods, agricultural goods, services? 🔹 What are some of the misses from Indian perspective in this agreement? With India signing several FTAs, why is this the “Mother of all Deals”? How does it compare it with other FTAs like the India-UK FTA? 🔹 Is the deal WTO compatible? What are its implications for the rules-based multilateral trading system? ▶️ To learn more about the discussion, watch the full recording on our YouTube channel : youtube.com/watch?v=ChoqjY33… #IndiaEUFTA #TradePolicy #PolicyDiscussion #ExpertDialogue #TradeAndEconomics

The newly-appointed Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, H.E. Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat today, marking the official assumption of his post as the Ambassador of the Kingdom of Spain to ASEAN. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda on his appointment and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s readiness to work closely with him and the Government of Spain to strengthen ASEAN-Spain relations, both through bilateral copperation and within the framework of the ASEAN-European Union Dialogue Partnership. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda underscored Spain’s commitment to advancing cooperation with ASEAN in strategic sectors, such as trade and investment, sustainable infrastructure, energy transition, digital transformation, and connectivity. Secretary-General Dr. Kao further encouraged the Ambassador to engage with the diplomatic community in Jakarta, in particular with the Committee of Permanent Representatives to ASEAN (CPR). Both sides looked forward to Spain's accession to the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) this year. Ambassador de Sicart Escoda also informed of Spain's intention to establish mechanisms for political dialogue and cooperation with ASEAN, in line with Spain's Strategy for the Asia-Pacific 2026–2029. Ambassador Bernardo de Sicart Escoda is the fifth Ambassador of Spain to ASEAN. He succeeds Ambassador Francisco Aguilera Aranda, who completed his tenure in July 2025.

In Malaysia, the arrival of Ramadan is often marked by the comforting aroma of bubur lambuk simmering in large pots near mosques and community halls. Traditionally prepared in the late afternoon, bubur lambuk is distributed just before iftar, the breaking of the fast. Community members and volunteers gather to cook and share the dish, reflecting the spirit of togetherness and generosity that characterises Ramadan across the region. Made with rice, coconut milk, aromatic spices such as lemongrass, ginger, and coriander, and often beef or chicken, each region in Malaysia has its own variation of the recipe. A 10th March report in The Wall Street Journal says the fighting around the Strait of Hormuz has produced an unexpected outcome: Iran’s oil exports have surged above pre-war levels even while overall Gulf oil flows have collapsed. Before the war, Iran was exporting roughly 1.6 million barrels per day (b/d) of crude, and around 90% of those shipments were going to China, mainly to independent “teapot” refineries. According to tanker-tracking data cited by the Journal,Iran’s exports briefly jumped to about 3.66 million b/d in late February, more than double its normal export rate. At the same time, the total amount of oil moving through the Strait of Hormuz has collapsed. Normally about 20 million barrels per day—roughly one-fifth of global oil supply—passes through the strait. During the crisis, tanker traffic has fallen toaround 1.6 million b/d, roughly 20% of normal levels. The reason Iran’s exports have held up is structural. Most mainstream shipping companies and insurers have withdrawn from the area because of war risk. But Iran already relies heavily on a sanctions-evading “shadow fleet” of tankers, which continue to load oil from terminals such as Kharg Island and move shipments through the strait. Because other Gulf producers depend on conventional shipping and Western insurance, their exports have been disrupted far more severely. As a result, within the limited traffic that still moves through Hormuz,Iranian cargoes now represent a disproportionately large share. The report concludes that the crisis has created a paradox in global oil markets:overall Gulf exports have plunged, yet Iran—whose crude largely goes to China—has managed to increase shipments, exploiting its control over the geography of the strait and its existing shadow-fleet trade network.

Ayon kay Philippine Interisland Shipping Association o PISA Chairman at owner ng Philippine Archipelago Ferries Corpotation na operator ng Fastcat na si Christopher Pastrana, makatwiran lamang ang ipinatupad nilang fare increase dahil sa napakalaki na ng itinaas ng presyo ng fuel na malaking bahagi ng kanilang gastusin sa operasyon. “Before the Middle East crisis ang presyo lang po ng crude oil sa Mindoro at sa ibang part sa ibang lalawigan is about P53 to P55 per liter ngayon nasa P89, almost P90 na in span of one week, everyday tumataas, 80 percent of our cost as of today is already fuel, saan po natin kukunin yung pagtaas ng krudo?" sabi ni Pastrana. Nilinaw din ni Pastrana na bagama’t nagtaas sila ng pamasahe, iginiit niya na pasok pa rin ito sa kanilang publish rates na inaprubahan ng MARINA. Taong 2022 pa umano ang kanilang publish rates pero hindi umano nila ginamit ito dahil ang pinagbasehan nila ay ang market forces. Ayon kay Pastrana, kung nais aniyang mapababa ang pamasahe sa barko ay dapat na magpatupad din ang gobyerno ng mga hakbang na makakatulong sa kanila kagaya ng mga pagbabawas sa binabayarang tax at iba pang bayarin sa pantalan. Bilang hakbang sa pagtitipid sa pagkonsumo sa krudo, sinabi ni Pastrana na maraming shipping lines ang nagbawas na ng biyahe. ऐसा प्रतीत हो रहा है कि प्रधानमंत्री Narendra Modi पूरी तरह Donald Trump के दबाव में काम कर रहे हैं। हालात ऐसे दिख रहे हैं मानो भारत जैसे महान देश को अमेरिका का उपनिवेश बना दिया गया हो। Trump जो भी आदेश देते हैं, मोदी जी उसे मानो “जी हुज़ूर” कहकर स्वीकार कर लेते हैं। आज स्थिति यह है कि हमारे प्रधानमंत्री को कमजोर बताया जा रहा है और उन्हें Blackmail किए जाने की बातें सामने आ रही हैं। यहाँ तक कि अमेरिका के छोटे-छोटे अधिकारी भी भारत के प्रधानमंत्री का मज़ाक उड़ा रहे हैं। आख़िर ऐसी क्या मजबूरी है कि मोदी जी बार-बार Trump के सामने झुक रहे हैं? अगर उन्हें लगता है कि Trump के पास उनके कुछ ऐसे राज हैं जो सामने आने से उन्हें नुकसान पहुँचा सकते हैं, तो उन्हें तुरंत इस्तीफ़ा दे देना चाहिए — लेकिन देश को संकट में नहीं डालना चाहिए। - @ArvindKejriwal जी, राष्ट्रीय संयोजक, आम आदमी पार्टी #KejriwalOnLPGShortage Video

The World Health Organization (WHO) has donated 25 metric tonnes of essential medicines and medical supplies to support the treatment of cancer patients in Afghanistan. According to WHO’s Afghanistan office, with financial support from the European Union, the NCD kits will help provide treatment for around 16,200 people, while the anti-cancer medicines will be used to treat more than 13,000 patients over the next six months. #DidYouKnow Madhya Pradesh’s Dakshata Unnayan (DU) programme showed how focused remediation and activity-based learning can improve student performance. Launched in 2018, the programme aligned remedial workbooks with clear learning outcomes and helped teachers track each child’s progress. Simple, hands-on activities using locally available materials made learning more engaging and practical. Within a few months, 15–20% of students moved up by at least one learning level across subjects. The State also reformed assessments by shifting from rote-based exams to competency-focused evaluation. These achievements have been documented as Best Practices on the NITI for States (NFS) Knowledge Portal—an initiative under the State Support Mission. The Avenger-class mine countermeasure ships USS Devastator, USS Dextrous, USS Gladiator, and USS Sentry had their final ceremony in Bahrain in September 2025 and are now being transported back to the U.S. expected to be unloaded in Philadelphia tomorrow. They were based in the Persian Gulf for decades. Their mission was to detect and destroy naval mines and keep shipping lanes open, especially in the Strait of Hormuz. This role became especially critical after the 1980s Tanker War, when naval mines posed a major danger to traffic in the Gulf. With their retirement, the U.S. Navy no longer has dedicated Avenger-class minehunters in the Middle East. Only four of these ships remain active, and they are based in Japan. The Navy is now transitioning the mission to Littoral Combat Ships (LCS) equipped with mine countermeasure packages, including unmanned surface vessels, underwater drones, and airborne mine-hunting systems. पूरे देश में गैस की भारी किल्लत होने लगी है, गैस एजेंसियों के आगे लंबी-लंबी लाइनें लग रही हैं। होटलों और रेस्टोरेंटों को सिलेंडर नहीं मिल रहे हैं, वहाँ खाना बनना बंद हो चुका है। गैस आधारित तमाम फैक्टरियाँ बंद हो चुकी हैं। लेकिन सरकार और पेट्रोलियम मंत्रालय कह रहा है कि कहीं कोई किल्लत नहीं है। आखिर केंद्र की भाजपा सरकार देश और जनता को ग़लत जानकारी क्यों दे रहा है? “भारत में हमारे सहयोगी अच्छे लोग हैं। उन्होंने पहले भी रूस से प्रतिबंधित तेल खरीदना बंद किया था। हमने उन्हें कुछ समय के लिए रूसी तेल लेने की इजाज़त दी है।” यह बयान व्हाइट हाउस की प्रवक्ता ने एक आधिकारिक प्रेस कॉन्फ़्रेंस में दिया। इससे पहले भी अमेरिकी प्रशासन की ओर से इसी तरह के संकेत दिए जा चुके हैं। लेकिन हैरानी की बात है कि इस पर मोदी सरकार पूरी तरह खामोश है। सवाल उठता है — जो प्रधानमंत्री खुद को 56 इंच के सीने वाला नेता बताते हैं, वे आज इस मुद्दे पर चुप क्यों हैं? क्या भारत की विदेश नीति अब वॉशिंगटन की अनुमति से तय होगी? देश जानना चाहता है — आखिर ऐसी क्या मजबूरी है कि सरकार खुलकर जवाब देने से बच रही है? At the invitation of H.E. Ma. Christina A. Roque, Secretary of Trade and Industry of the Republic of the Philippines and Chair of the ASEAN Economic Ministers’ (AEM) Meeting in 2026, Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, will lead the delegation of the ASEAN Secretariat to participate in the 32nd ASEAN Economic Ministers’ (AEM) Retreat 2026, scheduled to be held in Taguig, the Philippines, on 13 March 2026. This year’s Retreat will see discussions on the recent global and regional economic outlook, the Philippines’ Priority Economic Deliverables (PEDs) for its Chairship in 2026 under the theme “Navigating Our Future, Together,” ASEAN Economic Community (AEC) Performance Monitoring, as well as a number of key initiatives including the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA) negotiations, Timor-Leste’s accession to ASEAN economic agreements, and ASEAN’s external economic relations, among others. The Ministers will also have dialogue sessions with the ASEAN Business Advisory Council (ASEAN-BAC), the Economic Research Institute for ASEAN and East Asia (ERIA), as well as with the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

I performed poorly in school, not because im some big brain science brain man, but because the way schools work bothered me. I perform really well without structure. I am free flow. Schools put up educational standards in a vague generalization of "one size fits all", which is structured material and testing. Obviously many kids do good with this, but I never did. I have a hard time with surface level information and constantly ask "why" (to the annoyance of my teachers, probably) and would become bored and confused by not knowing "how something works" and just being presented with "this is just how it works". Again, this doesn't make me some super genius or whatever, but it's a reflection on different learning styles and how some people don't do too good with structured learning. It's also a reflection on how I personally think and how other people think. It is what it is, dawg. Thanks for coming to my TED talk.

Yeah, so basically the reason why nerds who work on computers are so weird about universities and stuff is because of the weird cultural shift that occurred when the internet really started booming Historically, universities were the only places people could get high quality information, labs, advanced literature, etc etc. They were higher education institutions. When the internet exploded, more and more information was dumped online in extreme volumes. Suddenly, in just a few decades, there is more information online than in universities. Universities no longer possess the elitism or secret knowledge or information they once had. Of course, for argument sake, some exceptions are still place, such as for healthcare. You can read all you want about surgery online, but you need to attend a university to get formal training. Anyway, when cybersecurity first popped up, universities didn't really have any material on it. They did, but it wasn't like it was online with forums and stuff (IRC, whatever) where information was pouring out every day. The problem universities faced was how fast information traveled. The information taught in universities is relatively old. In the age of the internet information is fast. Lightning fast. Everyday I see new malware papers being released. It would be virtually impossible for a university to keep up with this pace. So, the other thing is universities have structure and stuff. Being an internet nerd does not require structure and stuff. Many cybersecurity nerds thrived on being an autodidact and self exploring. When the autodidact nerds find a university nerd, there is a cultural divide whereas autodidact nerd thinks university nerd wasted their time and money and could have learned it themselves. University nerd sees autodidact nerd as someone who (probably) doesn't have an education or feels a bit elitist because they graduated from a university. The elitism they feel circles back to the historical stuff with universities, the secret knowledge, the alumni, etc. Ultimately, nerds can do whatever. Old heads and new head autodidact nerds will thrive and be driven by curiosity forever. Doing this requires immense self discipline and being infinitely hungry for information. University nerds may feel the same, but may feel lost without guidance and are more reliant on structure. University nerds can do well in our field as long as get their feet wet in university stuff, then continue self education outside of the university. Neither is wrong per say, just a different learning style and preferred method.

El 5 de julio de 1954, tras grabar su primer sencillo en Sun Records, la canción fue difundida por Dewey Phillips en el programa "Red, Hot & Blue" de la emisora WHBQ. La reacción del público se tradujo en decenas de llamadas a la radio y la congregación de seguidores frente a la emisora. Esa noche, el entorno de Presley instauró una tradición que perduró: celebrar cada logro con un pedido nocturno de hamburguesas Krystal. Dewey Phillips ordenó hasta cien sliders para los fans reunidos fuera del estudio, convirtiendo el gesto en parte de la cultura del grupo. Además, investigadores estadounidenses y europeos crearon atlas tridimensionales y biológicos que documentan la dinámica de tipos celulares y regiones cerebrales durante el desarrollo postnatal, facilitando el estudio comparativo y la investigación de trastornos neuropsiquiátricos. La regularidad y las necesidades individuales son factores determinantes para la higiene y la protección de la piel. El momento ideal depende de los hábitos, el tipo de piel y la rutina diaria. Los expertos subrayan que mantener una rutina diaria constante es más importante que el horario específico. Entre las recomendaciones, se destaca limitar el baño a entre cinco y diez minutos, usar agua tibia y aplicar crema hidratante luego de secarse. Las personas que practican ejercicio o se exponen a suciedad durante el día deben ducharse al finalizar esas actividades. Los especialistas recomiendan evitar jabones con fragancia y no usar esponjas de baño. BREAKING 🚨: The Earth's core confirmed to have 'reversed' its spin. Yes, the ground beneath your feet quietly changed direction and nobody told you. For decades, scientists assumed Earth’s inner core rotated slightly faster than the rest of the planet, spinning independently like a metal seed buried 5,000 kilometers below everything you’ve ever touched. A solid iron ball roughly the size of the Moon, suspended inside liquid outer core, operating on its own schedule. That assumption just collapsed. Seismic data picked up something that took years to confirm because the implications were too strange to rush. The inner core didn’t just slow down. It stopped. Then it began rotating the other way. What makes this genuinely unsettling is what the inner core’s rotation actually does. It generates and shapes Earth’s magnetic field, the invisible force field standing between all biological life on this planet and the full radiation output of the Sun. Animals navigate by it. Satellites depend on it. Your DNA has evolved inside it for hundreds of millions of years. The inner core rotates because of electromagnetic coupling with the liquid outer core and gravitational pulls from the mantle above it. When those forces shift enough to reverse a solid iron mass that weighs more than the entire Moon, something in that deep system changed significantly. And we felt none of it on the surface. No earthquake. No announcement. No signal. It happened in complete geological silence while humans were busy with everything else. The last confirmed slowdown period in the data aligns suspiciously close to measurable anomalies in surface magnetic field strength recorded over the past two decades. Compasses are already slightly less reliable than they were in 1900. The magnetic north pole has been accelerating its movement so fast that navigation systems have needed emergency recalibration ahead of schedule. A reversing inner core doesn’t cause a magnetic pole flip overnight. But it is a variable inside the same equation. The planet is a machine running processes humans have never directly observed. We read its behavior through tremors from distant earthquakes bouncing seismic waves through layers we cannot reach. Everything we know about the core comes from shadows and echoes. And those shadows just told us the engine changed gears. "Primero los pobres" Decía el viejo meado.. Pero los pobres de sus hijos y de sus cómplices. Se filtra lo que cobró Belinda, Galilea Montijo y los demás cantantes de la fiesta de XV en Tabasco. Lean un extracto de la columna de Salvador García Soto 👇 "Vaya escándalo el que generó en las redes sociales y en los medios el video de una fiesta de XV años de una jovencita originaria de Villahermosa, Tabasco. Y es que el nivel de lujo, excesos y ostentación que se derrochó en esa fiesta no se había visto ni siquiera en las celebraciones de los políticos y gobernantes, vaya ni siquiera en las fiestas de millonarios mexicanos. Fue tal el exceso para celebrar a una jovencita de nombre Mafer, que de inmediato los videos que compartieron en redes sociales sus propios padres y sus amigos que acudieron al evento, empezaron a generar reacciones de sorpresa, indignación y muchas preguntas sobre el origen de la fortuna del orgulloso padre, quien resultó ser un empresario tabasqueño, amigo del gobernador morenista, Javier May, y contratista favorito de Pemex en este y el pasado sexenio. Juan Carlos Guerrero Rojas es el nombre del padre de Mafer, quien mostró a los tabasqueños y a todo México la abundancia que lo ha favorecido en sus negocios con el gobierno. Y es que a la fiesta acudieron artistas, influencers, cantantes y toda una pléyade de estrellas que fueron contratados para felicitar a la niña, cantarle las mañanitas y amenizar su fiesta. El enlace para contratar, por ejemplo a Belinda y a Galilea Montijo, fue el maquillista Alfonso Whaitsman, quien se promociona en sus redes como “Celebrity make up artist”. Se dice que Galilea cobró entre 1 y 2 millones de pesos por hacer de anfitriona y conducir la ceremonia de los XV años, mientras que la cantante Belinda, solo por ir a cantarle las mañanitas a la quinceañera y sentarse un rato en la mesa con ella y sus padres, le habrían pagado más de 4 millones de pesos. Eso sí, el mismo padre de la quinceañera comentó que para que “Beli” aceptara venir desde España donde radica a cantarle a su hija las mañanitas al estilo de Marilyn Monroe, tuvo que ponerle un avión privado para que la llevara y la trajera. Del reguetonrero J. Balvin se dice que cobró entre 600 y 700 mil dólares por amenizar la fiesta, en tanto que Xavi, cantante de corridos tumbados, cobró arriba de 200 mil dólares, y ya para la tornafiesta, el grupo Matute cobró arriba de 100 mil dólares. Si a eso se le agrega toda la producción y decoración de la fiesta, que incluyó replicas exactas de tiendas Hermes, McDonalds y un mundo de pantallas, el cálculo estimado de lo que costaron los 15 años de Mafer a su padre es de hasta 2 millones de dólares. ¿Quién puede gastarse eso en una fiesta de XV años? No hay registro, ni siquiera en las celebraciones de políticos o millonarios, de algo que iguale los excesos que se vieron en la húmeda Villahermosa por un contratista de Pemex que se dice cercano al actual gobernador morenista May y al otro tabasqueño que dirigió Pemex en el sexenio pasado, Octavio Ramírez Oropeza. Se ve que mientras Pemex ya no genera mucha riqueza para los mexicanos y para el presupuesto, y más bien nos está costando miles de millones de pesos para pagar sus deudas y quebrantos, para los contratistas amigos del poder, Pemex sigue siendo una mina de oro, tanto que pueden derrochar millones de pesos para festejar una fiesta de su hija…"

POR QUÉ FORTALECER TENDONES Y LIGAMENTOS ES ESENCIAL PARA MOVERSE SIN DOLOR NI LIMITACIONES Las articulaciones y los tendones son componentes fundamentales del aparato locomotor. Su adecuado funcionamiento permite la movilidad y la estabilidad necesarias para realizar actividades cotidianas y deportivas. Diversos especialistas advierten que el cuidado de estos tejidos incide en la calidad de vida, la prevención de enfermedades crónicas y la recuperación tras la actividad física. La Organización Mundial de la Salud señala que los problemas en las articulaciones y las lesiones de tendones son una de las principales causas de dolor y discapacidad en personas de todas las edades. El fortalecimiento de estos tejidos, junto a hábitos saludables, contribuye a prolongar la capacidad funcional y reduce el riesgo de complicaciones asociadas al sedentarismo o al sobreuso. Los expertos recomiendan incorporar programas de ejercicio progresivos y consultar con un profesional de la salud antes de iniciar cualquier rutina, para maximizar los beneficios y prevenir lesiones. POR QUÉ LOS COLIBRÍES APARECEN EN PATIOS Y JARDINES La presencia de colibríes en patios, balcones y jardines urbanos indica un entorno saludable y con diversidad de flora nativa, según la National Audubon Society. Estas aves eligen espacios con flores ricas en néctar, arbustos y agua limpia. Su llegada también tiene un significado cultural y espiritual en diferentes partes del mundo, asociándose con esperanza, renovación y protección. El principal alimento de los colibríes es el néctar de flores, aunque también consumen pequeños insectos y arañas. Para atraerlos, se recomienda plantar especies autóctonas ricas en néctar y evitar pesticidas. La visita frecuente de estas aves revela la importancia de conservar la biodiversidad y promueve la polinización de plantas, simbolizando la armonía entre ser humano y naturaleza. 🔗 Infobae: infob.ae/4ddp0zV

LA MÚSICA FUERTE EN EL GIMNASIO APORTA MOTIVACIÓN EXTRA: LO QUE DESCUBRIÓ LA CIENCIA Un estudio realizado en Estados Unidos concluyó que bajar el volumen de la música durante las clases grupales en gimnasios no afecta la motivación ni el esfuerzo de quienes entrenan. Los investigadores midieron la percepción de esfuerzo, la preferencia de volumen y los síntomas auditivos en un grupo de participantes y observaron que la reducción del volumen no produjo cambios relevantes en la energía ni en la motivación. El equipo responsable del trabajo advirtió que el volumen alto de la música eleva el riesgo de daño auditivo y recomendó informar sobre estos riesgos, ofrecer protección y utilizar medidores de sonido en tiempo real en los gimnasios. Los especialistas señalaron que la música fuerte no suma motivación, pero sí puede afectar la salud auditiva. 🔗Infobae: infob.ae/4sCdqTs

The value of extreme precision Math Files (@Math_files) In 1798, a scientist effectively “weighed” the Earth — without leaving his laboratory. The English scientist Henry Cavendish designed an incredibly sensitive experiment. Inside a quiet wooden shed, he hung a horizontal rod from a very thin wire. Two small lead spheres were attached to the ends of the rod. Nearby, he placed two much larger lead balls. Because of gravity, the large spheres slightly pulled the smaller ones. The force was extremely tiny — so small that the rod twisted by only a minute fraction of a degree. Yet that tiny twist held a big secret. By carefully measuring this small movement, Cavendish determined the strength of the gravitational attraction between objects. From this, scientists could calculate the mass of the entire Earth. His estimate was remarkably close. Cavendish calculated Earth’s mass to be about 6 × 10²⁴ kilograms, while modern measurements give 5.97 × 10²⁴ kilograms. Sometimes the biggest discoveries come from measuring the smallest forces. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/Math_files/status/2031348695921471489#m

فريقنا الآن، الذي يضم عسكريين وكذلك رستم عميروف، في طريقه إلى منطقة الخليج، حيث يمكن لرجالنا المساهمة في حماية الأرواح والمساعدة في استقرار الوضع. نحن نرى التحديات التي تبرز الآن نتيجة الضربات الإيرانية، وفي ظل هذه الحرب التي قد تطول. في الواقع، قام النظام الإيراني بإغلاق مضيق هرمز، وهو أحد الطرق الرئيسية لإمدادات النفط والغاز إلى السوق العالمية. وهذا يمثل عامل زعزعة استقرار كبير. لا أحد في العالم قادر حتى الآن على القول كم سيستمر هذا الوضع، لكن من المهم أن يبدأ العمل الفعلي لحماية الأرواح في أسرع وقت ممكن. الاستقرار ضروري لنا أيضاً. ومن الضروري أن يواصل أولئك الذين يتوجهون اليوم إلى أوكرانيا طلباً للدعم، تقديم المساعدة لنا أيضاً، ولا سيما لدفاعنا الجوي. لقد عرضنا على الولايات المتحدة بالفعل في العام الماضي اتفاقاً بشأن الطائرات المسيّرة. وهذه هي الرؤية الصحيحة: أن نكون معاً في إنتاج الطائرات المسيّرة وفي استخدامها. والجميع يرى الآن أنه لا يوجد بديل لهذا المسار. تمتلك أوكرانيا أكبر خبرة في العالم في مواجهة الطائرات المسيّرة الهجومية، ومن دون خبرتنا سيكون من الصعب جداً على منطقة الخليج والشرق الأوسط بأكمله، وكذلك شركائنا في أوروبا وأمريكا، بناء منظومة دفاع قوية. نحن مستعدون لمساعدة كل من يساعدنا ويساعد أوكرانيا. وسيعمل رستم عميروف مع عسكريينا، ومع أجهزة الاستخبارات، ووزارة الدفاع، ووزارة الخارجية، على إعداد اتفاقات محددة. إن أوكرانيا شريك موثوق في تعزيز الأمن، وهذا ليس فقط منظوراً أمنياً لنا، بل هو أيضاً منظور اقتصادي. حماية لأوكرانيا، وتعاون مع الشركاء، وتطوير للصناعات الأوكرانية. كل ما تعلمه الأوكرانيون للدفاع عن أنفسهم يمكن أن يصبح أساساً عالمياً للأمن وأساساً عالمياً لحياة آمنة.

La música fuerte en el gimnasio aporta motivación extra: lo que descubrió la ciencia Un estudio realizado en Estados Unidos concluyó que bajar el volumen de la música durante las clases grupales en gimnasios no afecta la motivación ni el esfuerzo de quienes entrenan. Los investigadores midieron la percepción de esfuerzo, la preferencia de volumen y los síntomas auditivos en un grupo de participantes y observaron que la reducción del volumen no produjo cambios relevantes en la energía ni en la motivación. El equipo responsable del trabajo advirtió que el volumen alto de la música eleva el riesgo de daño auditivo y recomendó informar sobre estos riesgos, ofrecer protección y utilizar medidores de sonido en tiempo real en los gimnasios. AlphaEvolve, an AI agent inspired by AlphaGo’s search methods, is discovering how to make computers run more efficiently. 💻 It recently was used to discover a novel way to multiply matrices — the core math powering nearly all modern AI. By optimizing code at its most basic level, we’re making entire ecosystems, from data centers to quantum computing, faster and more sustainable.

AlphaGo’s tech has moved from the game board to the hardest math on the planet. 🥈 Similar approaches helped AlphaProof, paired with AlphaGeometry, to become the first AI systems to earn silver at the International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO). 🥇 Recently, an advanced version of Gemini Deep Think went even further, achieving gold-medal performance at the 2025 IMO. We’re now applying this reasoning to the most complex, open-ended challenges across science and engineering.

What has this war done to US military competitiveness with China? In my view, it’s been devastating. Here’s why: 1. The US has consumed years worth of production of key missile interceptors and standoff weapons. These will take a lot of money and a lot of time to replenish. And at the end of those years of replenishment, the US will stand exactly where it stood at the beginning of this war. Meanwhile, China would have accumulated years of additional offensive SoWs, missiles and drones. The disparity between Chinese offense and American defense will grow significantly. 2. This war demonstrated the actual, practical interplay of Chinese and Russian high resolution orbital imagery and targeting assistance, with cheap Iranian drones. And it has been remarkably effective. These tactics and all the learning from their employment will be available to China with three distinct advantages. First, China has much greater industrial capacity to build drones. Second, they will have a tighter kill chain as imagery, targeting and kinetics would all be controlled by China. Third, the interplay of these tactics with the significantly more sophisticated Chinese offensive and defensive capabilities will make the threat orders of magnitude more potent. 3. To many observers, US equipment comes across as “not the future” in very distinct ways. Many Arab leaders are already asking whether the bases and equipment were supposed to protect them, or if they were supposed to protect the bases. This sentiment should not be discounted, and it will hurt exports and sales for sure. Who will benefit? China and Türkiye. The fact is that cheap Iranian drones blowing up $1.1B radars and THAAD subsystems on video cannot be ignored. Domestically-manufactured surface to air missiles shooting down $32M drones cannot be ignored. Neither can civilian trucks launching ballistic missiles produced en-masse. Is the “massively expensive, exquisite platform” approach really the future? 4. The Iranian strategy of Mosaic decentralized defense is very instructive for China and many others. It is human ingenuity overcoming the challenges of sophisticated EW, intel, and other adversary advantages. If US EW is superior, or if US intelligence is superior and can degrade command and control, how do you respond? This war has presented a practical template which I’m sure will be refined further. 5. Wearing my AI hat, this war has been a dataset goldmine for China. You’ve seen the public, mizar vision imagery. That’s impressive already. But what you haven’t seen is the Chinese military’s far more impressive multi-spectral imagery of live ops. And the electronic intelligence they have undoubtedly built while watching F-35s, F-22s and various US munitions - including new ones, such as the “stealthy” black Tomahawk - in action. This data isn’t just for human learning any more, it will also be collected to build automated (anomaly) detection and threat classification models. The structure of ops will also be broken down into discrete states and used to train predictive time series models. Much more to be said on this topic, but this suffices for now.

Opened the second Nuclear Energy Summit in Paris today with President @EmmanuelMacron. Hosted by 🇫🇷 @francediplo_EN in cooperation with the @IAEAorg, #NES2026 comes at a moment when nuclear energy is increasingly recognized as a tool of autonomy, industrial competitiveness and geopolitical resilience. When we speak about development, we speak about electrification, digitalization and artificial intelligence. In all these areas, we will need reliable and predictable answers. Nuclear energy is one of those answers. Reliable, low-carbon and independent of weather or fuel supply disruptions, nuclear power provides stable electricity systems and supports energy security. Its baseload reliability also enables the deployment of renewables and will be essential as electricity demand surges, including from the AI revolution. Today, around 60 countries are considering nuclear energy. But momentum alone is not enough: nuclear must be investible. Predictable policies, robust supply chains and accessible financing are essential to reduce costs and scale up its deployment, alongside greater standardization so the industry can move toward repeatable designs. We are making great progress. The @IAEAorg is working with international financial institutions to expand access to nuclear energy, including partnerships with the @WorldBank, @AgendaCAF, @TheOPECFund and @ADB_HQ. Nuclear power is not simply a nice-to-have, or a cleaner option. It is a strategic opportunity and we know it. As the global hub of expertise across the nuclear lifecycle, the @IAEAorg will continue supporting countries as they move to seize it.

ESCÁNER CEREBRAL REVELA CÓMO LA KETAMINA ACTÚA EN EL CEREBRO DE PACIENTES CON DEPRESIÓN Un equipo de científicos japoneses logró observar en tiempo real cómo la ketamina altera regiones específicas del cerebro en personas con depresión resistente al tratamiento. El estudio identificó modificaciones cuantificables en el receptor AMPA, asociadas a mejoras clínicas, y diferencias notorias entre pacientes con depresión resistente y voluntarios sanos. La investigación, realizada en 34 pacientes japoneses y 49 personas sanas como grupo de control, mostró que la ketamina genera variaciones medibles en la densidad de los receptores AMPA en regiones corticales y subcorticales. Los expertos señalan que la acción de la ketamina sobre este receptor solo se había evidenciado en modelos animales y destacan la necesidad de estudios adicionales, advirtiendo sobre el uso médico controlado debido a posibles efectos adversos. BREAKING: A record 39.3 million barrels of sanctioned crude are sitting on tankers off China's coast. The stockpile includes 30.2 million barrels from Iran, 5.6 million from Venezuela, and 3.5 million from Russia. This is up +454% from October and +17% from levels seen prior to the Iran war. ~77% of the crude is Iranian, but fresh offers have declined due to the ongoing war. Furthermore, ~66% of the tankers are anchored in the Yellow Sea, with the rest in the South China Sea, indicating that most of the supply is parked close to China’s major refining hubs. This floating stockpile acts as a buffer for China's private refiners, known as teapots, who have traditionally been the biggest buyers of discounted Iranian crude. China can afford to weather the storm for now.

But as history has always shown, no one remains above the Constitution forever. But those who believe themselves to be above the Constitution inevitably face the long arm of the law. Today, expressing clear displeasure over the functioning of the Election Commission, the Supreme Court of India has issued decisive directions that Appellate Tribunals be constituted, comprising former Chief Justices of High Courts and former High Court judges, to hear appeals against exclusions; supplementary list be appended to the final voter list published on 28 February 2026; and technical disruptions in the ECI portal prior to March 7, 2026 be rectified immediately. This is nothing short of a stinging rebuke to the Bangla-Birodhi BJP-ECI nexus and a moral victory for the Maa, Mati, Manush of Bengal. In light of these landmark developments, I placed before Smt. Mamata Banerjee our humble appeal to conclude the dharna at Dharmatala, which she graciously accepted. But this is not the end. It is only the beginning. For the next 50 days, we will continue this battle on the streets, in the courts, in the Parliament, and among the people until the Delhi zamindars are uprooted from every single booth in Bengal and thrown out with precisely the contempt and fury they have so thoroughly earned.
